result.summary: The home feed is mostly rendered correctly, but one section heading shows a raw localization key instead of user-facing text. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item and the bottom-cut card are expected scroll behaviour.

issues.description: The heading of the second restaurant section displays the raw, unresolved i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title such as 'Popular right now'.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the translation key exists in the active locale's string resources and is resolved correctly. Add a human-readable fallback string so raw keys never reach the UI.
